tutorial.title: Quick tutorial: saturate a drum loop
steps: On a track playing a drum loop, hold FUNC and press FX2, turn LEVEL to TAPEHEAD and press YES. Press FX2 to see DRIVE 36, TRIM 18 and COLOR NORM.
Turn DRIVE to 100: the peaks flatten and the kick thickens. Turn TRIM to about 40 to bring the level down. Switch COLOR to BRGT for more top end, NORM for a darker tone.
Choose NONE in FX2 SETUP to compare with the dry track. Re-selecting TAPEHEAD clears its internal state.
